account: Today seems quiet so far. During my scheduled morning market walk, several residents told me they had no news, and I have not seen any unusual incident. I bought a fresh loaf at the bakery stall. I asked freight about the docks and warehouse, but have heard no reply, so I cannot say whether there are problems there. The one unresolved matter is my 15:00 tea appointment: the appointment book names only 'the neighbour, dockside cottage, east bank,' without a host or precise address. The secretary has the book and said she would visit the cottages to identify the host before fifteen hundred. I take this to be an effort to clarify an incomplete invitation, not evidence of anything suspicious. I have now reached the road outside my home at 11:16, ahead of my noon lunch. My remaining appointments are town accounts at the office at 13:00, the dockside tea at 15:00, office again at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow's schedule includes a 10:00 grain inspection at the mill.
